answer.narrative: Campaign C0001, designated as Frankenstein, was a highly targeted operation conducted by moderately sophisticated and highly resourceful threat actors in early 2019. The campaign primarily relied on open source tools, including Empire (S0363), and earned its name from the actors' ability to piece together several unrelated open-source components. ATT&CK records indicate that this campaign uses 13 techniques, 14 subtechniques, and 1 software tool, but it is not currently attributed to any specific threat group.

results.sub_question: Retrieve details for Campaign with ID C0001.
results.query: MATCH (n:Campaign) WHERE n.attack_id IN $ids OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r]-(m) WITH n, CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE type(r) END AS rel, CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE startNode(r) = n END AS outgoing, CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE head(labels(m)) END AS neighbour_label, count(m) AS cnt WITH n, collect(CASE WHEN rel IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE {rel: rel, outgoing: outgoing, label: neighbour_label, count: cnt} END) AS raw WITH n, [f IN raw WHERE f IS NOT NULL] AS facets RETURN n.attack_id AS id, n.name AS name, n.properties_json AS properties_json, facets AS facets LIMIT 1
